notes.title: Next Patch for Mac OS X users.
notes.content:
Hello,
I'm xPathfinder who's the developer of 'Ace of Protectors'.

Today, I'm going to announce new future patch for Mac OS X users.
[b]Please mind this patch announcement is only for Mac OS X. So, if your operating system is not Mac, you are good to skip this announcement.[/b]

After the release of 'El Captian', the Keychain System was changed a little bit. So, this made compatibility problem with the game. That's why users using 'El Captian' or later versions are having crashes.
(If you're using any older versions like Yosemite, you may not have problem with this.)

However, I have a solution for this. I'll fix this compatibility probem as soon as possible. It might take 2 or 3 days to finish. I'll announce again when the patch's available.

Much thanks,
xPathfinder

notes.title: #7 Bugs Fix & New Achievement Feature
notes.content:
Hello,
I'm xPathfinder who's the developer of 'Ace of Protectors'.

[h1]# BUGS[/h1]
I've found and fixed a bug.
Here is a fixed bug.
[b]- Fixed the course selection controlling bug in Octasis.[/b]

[h1]# NEW ACHIEVEMENT FEATURE[/h1]
This is not to add new acihevements, but just fix for users' convenience.
Before the fix, you get one difficulty-related achievement when you clear the game. (Easy, Normal, or Ace.)
However, After the fix, now, you'll get all of lower-difficulties-related achievements when you clear the game. For example, If you clear the game as Ace difficulty, which is the most difficult in the game, you'll also get Easy and Normal difficulties-related achievements.

(+ You already cleared the game? Don't worry, just launch the game then load the game, then you'll get these achievements automatically.)

Have a good day.


Much thanks.
- xPathfinder, the developer of Ace of Protectors.

notes.title: About the problem with achieving any Steam Achievements.
notes.content:
Hello,
I'm xPathfinder who's the developer of 'Ace of Protectors'.

I've found few desktops have a problem that cannot achieve any Steam Achievements.
So, I'm currently checking the game's engine and trying to fix the codes.

I guess this might be a compatibility problem or a connection problem.
Please let me know these things if you have this problem.
1) Your desktop's spec.
2) Have you lost connection with Steam during playing?
3) Were you offline during playing?

Sorry for the trouble. I'll fix this problem as soon as I get any solution.

* Don't worry about losing your progress with Steam Achievement. When the problem is fixed, Steam and the game will automatically find what achievements you've done and let you achieve those.

Much thanks.
- xPathfinder, the developer of 'Ace of Protectors'.

notes.title: To Mac OSX users.
notes.content:
Hello, I'm xPathfinder who's the developer of 'Ace of Protectors'.
I'm here to tell you something to Mac OSX users.

Currently, I found few graphics cards might have a problem with launching.
The problem is,
When you launch 'Ace of Protectors' in Mac OSX, you may see only white full screen. 

Actually, The game is working well, just shows only white screen.
For this, 
First, Go to Desktop Screen by using Command + Tab key or whatever you want. (Don't terminate the game during this work.)
Then, Return to Ace of Protector's Screen. This will work and you will see the game's main menu.

If you have any problem, Please add and message me.
Steam URL : http://steamcommunity.com/id/xPathfinder

Thank you, Have a good day.
- xPathfinder
